task: Fix sum_values so it sums every value, including the last item, and handles an empty list.
Make is_palindrome case-insensitive and ignore spaces and punctuation; preserve Unicode letters and digits.
Fix median to return the average of the two middle numbers for even-length input without mutating the caller's list.
Make safe_average return None for an empty sequence and the arithmetic mean otherwise.
Fix unique_items to remove duplicates while preserving the first-seen order for any hashable values.
Fix discounted_total to apply the percentage discount to the subtotal and round only the final amount to cents.
Implement parse_bool for booleans and common trimmed, case-insensitive true/false strings; reject unknown values with ValueError.
Fix fibonacci so it returns 0 for n=0, 1 for n=1, and the standard Fibonacci number for positive n; reject negatives.
Correct invoice totals across invoice.py and money.py: apply the country tax rate to the discounted subtotal and round money consistently to cents.
Implement case-insensitive username lookup across app.py and helpers.py; return the full matching user or None, without mutating the list.
Fix slugify to lowercase, normalize accented letters, replace punctuation runs with one hyphen, and trim edge hyphens.
Implement retryDelay(attempt, baseMs, maxMs) as capped exponential backoff; attempt zero returns baseMs and invalid negatives return zero.
Fix server configuration across config.py and server.py: use port 8000 when APP_PORT is missing or blank, accept surrounding whitespace, and reject values outside 1..65535.
Fix CSV report totals across records.py and report.py: parse decimal amounts, ignore blank rows, and sum values without float rounding errors.
Fix TTL cache behavior across cache_store.py and cache_api.py: entries expire at the exact deadline and expired values must be treated as misses.
Fix request retry behavior across retry.js and policy.js: retry only transient 429/5xx errors and stop after the configured attempt limit.
Fix safe path resolution across paths.py and downloads.py: reject traversal, absolute paths, and encoded dot segments while allowing normal nested files under the root.
Fix pagination across pagination.py and api.py: use a zero-based offset cursor, return at most page_size items, and report the next cursor only when more items remain.
